summary.text: Ryan Kelly is an educator and former federal civil servant running for NJ-3 on the "Affordability, Accountability, People Party" ballot line. By his own account his background spans public service, education and civil rights, including work at the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, and he describes his campaign as focused on affordability, accountability and practical governance.

paragraphs.text: Kelly attended Woodland Park High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University in 2005, and received a graduate degree from Monmouth University in 2007.
WHYY describes him as an educator and a former federal civil servant who spent 13 years with the Department of Homeland Security in government operations and program administration.
He was previously a member of the Lake Como Borough Council in Monmouth County, according to WHYY.
